caption: The drawing depicts a patchwork quilt composed of twelve rectangular panels arranged in a grid with three columns and four rows. Each panel features a simple geometric illustration of a house, varying in color and design, with rectangular windows and triangular or trapezoidal roofs. The colors of the house panels include shades of brown, pink, orange, green, beige, gray, and blue. The panels are bordered and separated by strips of green fabric featuring a pattern of red flowers. The quilt's outer edge has a thin red border, and the upper left corner contains a small section of blue fabric with a partial pattern. The uneven edges and visible fabric folds suggest a textile medium.
title: Log Cabin Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
